description: This file defines the StringLoaderExtension class for Twig, a templating engine in PHP. It adds a custom Twig function 'template_from_string' to load templates directly from a string.

classes.name: StringLoaderExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension that provides a function to load templates from strings.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of TwigFunction objects, registering 'template_from_string' as a Twig function.

methods.name: templateFromString
methods.description: Creates a Twig template from a string, optionally with a name for error messages.
